{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check premises
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("Unique patient_id count:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())
print("Unique sites:", data['site'].unique())
print("Unique arms:", data['arm'].unique())
print("Unique severity levels:", data['severity'].unique())
print("Responded values:", data['responded'].unique())
print("-999 in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print("Assay_batch values:", data['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check if any patient has more than one sample_seq
patient_sample_counts = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
duplicate_patients = patient_sample_counts[patient_sample_counts > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", len(duplicate_patients))"}
